# Halo Meister 0.2.7

## Scenario objects

- Added Scenario tools for placing, facing, and destroying scenery and machines from the loaded mission palette.
- Added object visibility controls for scenery, machines, and crates already placed in the mission.
- Bumped the scripting bridge to 0.2.7. Setup marks an older installed bridge as stale so it can be repaired before these commands are used.

## Built-in mods

- Split the fuller character roster into its own pack. It adds usable characters and does not change combat behavior.
- Added optional per-character combat enhancements for Marines, Elites, Grunts, Jackals, Brutes, and Hunters.
- Campaign extras still supply the fuller vehicle, weapon, scenery, and machine palettes, plus the friend/foe scaffolds BOT spawn needs.

## Reference and interface

- Added searchable Game text and Subtitles pages for the bundled localization tables.
- Reworked Home, player tools, skulls, allegiance, squads, and the spawner so the live-tool groups are easier to scan.
- Localized more user-facing errors.

**Full comparison:** [`v0.2.5...v0.2.7`](https://github.com/xiashizq/halo-meister/compare/v0.2.5...v0.2.7)
